name: MTTSL
recent: MTT Shipping and Logistics Berhad 近期出现多项董事及大股东行使 ESOS 期权、闭市期交易申报，以及雇员认股计划新股上市。新闻方面，公司被报道正推进船队扩张与运力利用，并有券商开始覆盖该股。
notable: 董事及大股东在闭市期行使雇员认股计划期权，涉及 Managing Director、Executive Chairman、Executive Director 及 CFO 等。
公司根据雇员认股计划发行新股，并已在马来西亚交易所上市。
新闻标题显示公司正推进船队扩张与运力利用，并有券商开始覆盖该股。
risks: 多名董事及大股东在闭市期行使期权并产生股权变动，需留意后续持股变化。
新闻标题提及航运成本压力持续，可能影响行业营运环境。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，公司营收为 MYR 360,358,000，净利润为 MYR 94,509,000，净利率 26.2%；营收环比增长 20.8%，净利润环比增长 44.5%，上一季度净利率为 21.9%。

recent_en: MTT Shipping and Logistics Berhad recently saw multiple announcements on directors and substantial shareholders exercising ESOS options, closed-period dealings, and listing of new ESOS shares. In the news, the company was reported to be pursuing fleet expansion and utilisation, and a broker initiated coverage on the stock.
notable_en: Directors and substantial shareholders exercised ESOS options during the closed period, involving the Managing Director, Executive Chairman, Executive Directors and CFO.
The company issued new shares under its Employees' Share Option Scheme, which were listed on Bursa Malaysia.
News headlines indicate the company is pursuing fleet expansion and utilisation, and a broker initiated coverage on the stock.
risks_en: Several directors and substantial shareholders exercised options during the closed period, resulting in changes in their shareholdings; subsequent shareholding changes should be monitored.
News headlines mention persistent shipping cost pressures, which may affect the industry operating environment.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 360,358,000 and net income was MYR 94,509,000, with a net margin of 26.2%; revenue grew 20.8% QoQ and net income grew 44.5% QoQ, versus a net margin of 21.9% in the previous quarter.
